rules.statement: A landlord has a tacit hypothec over the proceeds of sale of movable property in the hands of a person who knowingly has had the property sold in execution of a decree in his favour and drawn the money himself.
rules.supporting_quote: The tacit hypothec that a landlord has over the invecta el illata in the house let out attaches, in the case of movable property, to the proceeds sale of such property in the hands of a person who knowingly has had the property sold in execution of a decree in his favour and drawn the money himself.
